mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ${table} (date, gross_sales, discounts, service_fee, tax, adj_amount, tender_amount, diners, tables_used, returning_customers, new_customers) VALUES (#{d.date}, #{d.gross_sales}, #{d.discounts}, #{d.service_fee}, #{d.tax}, #{d.adj_amount}, #{d.tender_amount}, #{d.diners}, #{d.tables_used}, #{d.returning_customers}, #{d.new_customers}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE gross_sales = VALUES(gross_sales), discounts = VALUES(discounts), service_fee = VALUES(service_fee), tax = VALUES(tax), adj_amount = VALUES(adj_amount), tender_amount = VALUES(tender_amount), diners = VALUES(diners), tables_used = VALUES(tables_used), returning_customers = VALUES(returning_customers), new_customers = VALUES(new_customers)

INSERT INTO ${table} (date, day_name, c_beverage, c_kitchen, c_grab, c_foodpanda, c_shopee) VALUES (#{c.date}, #{c.day_name}, #{c.c_beverage}, #{c.c_kitchen}, #{c.c_grab}, #{c.c_foodpanda}, #{c.c_shopee}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE day_name = VALUES(day_name), c_beverage = VALUES(c_beverage), c_kitchen = VALUES(c_kitchen), c_grab = VALUES(c_grab), c_foodpanda = VALUES(c_foodpanda), c_shopee = VALUES(c_shopee)
mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN target_system = 'j2' THEN ROUND(out_quantity * price, 2) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS supply_to_j2, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN target_system = 'j3' THEN ROUND(out_quantity * price, 2) ELSE 0 END), 0) AS supply_to_j3 FROM stockinout_data WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND out_quantity > 0 AND target_system IN ('j2', 'j3') AND date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate}
SELECT id, restaurant, `year_month`, current_stock FROM cost_month_stock WHERE restaurant = #{restaurant} AND `year_month` = #{yearMonth} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cost_month_stock (restaurant, `year_month`, current_stock) VALUES (#{m.restaurant}, #{m.year_month}, #{m.current_stock}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE current_stock = VALUES(current_stock)
